ammonia.reason: Short 60-day ripening and low deamination by mesophilic Lactococcus gives little NH3.

animal_barnyard.reason: Pasteurized cow milk and clean starter limit indole and p-cresol from tryptophan/tyrosine.

bitter.reason: Washed curd removes lactose and bitter hydrophobic peptides; low chymosin bitterness.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation so no C7-C11 methyl ketones.

browning.reason: Residual galactose/lactose plus casein gives moderate Maillard when heated.

buttery.reason: Mesophilic Lactococcus lactis biovar diacetylactis citrate metabolism yields diacetyl/acetoin.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Very limited lipolysis with no mold lipase so little free butanoic/hexanoic acid.

creaminess.reason: High moisture ~40% and 60% FDM with washed elastic curd gives smooth creamy mouthfeel.

crumbliness.reason: Cohesive pressed washed-curd calcium-phosphate network fractures little.

firmness.reason: Semi-hard moisture 38-41% and young proteolysis gives soft-elastic sliceable body.

floral_honey.reason: Minimal phenylalanine catabolism to phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol in young cheese.

fruity.reason: Low esterase activity and short age limit ethyl butanoate/hexanoate esterification.

goaty.reason: Cow milk fat lacks goat 4-methyloctanoic/4-ethyloctanoic branched acids.

malty_nutty.reason: Mild Strecker 2-/3-methylbutanal and propionic pathways during 1-3 month ripening.

melt.reason: pH ~5.2 intact para-casein with high moisture/fat allows good flow without oiling excessively.

mushroom_earthy.reason: No surface Geotrichum/Brevibacterium so almost no 1-octen-3-ol geosmin.

oil_off.reason: High fat-in-dry-matter ~60% releases moderate free oil on heating.

smoky.reason: Unsmoked make with no wood-smoke guaiacol/syringol deposition.

sour_vinegar.reason: Lactic acid from mesophilic starter to pH 5.2 with little acetic acid.

stretch.reason: Non-pasta-filata but pH 5.2 demineralized casein gives slight extensibility.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Pasteurization drives off dimethyl sulfide and no high-cook whey protein H2S.

sweet.reason: Washed curd low acidity and salt with diacetyl and sweet amino acids enhance sweetness.

umami.reason: Modest rennet and starter proteolysis releases some glutamate but no long-age accumulation.
